# vorbis 1.3.7

Source archive: https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/vorbis/libvorbis-1.3.7.tar.xz

SHA-256: `b33cc4934322bcbf6efcbacf49e3ca01aadbea4114ec9589d1b1e9d20f72954b`

Only library sources, public headers, and licensing material are retained.
The Zig build replaces upstream build scripts.

The build maps `alloca` to Clang’s `__builtin_alloca`.
